name: @w6w-apps/wistia
description: Manage Wistia media and folders, read captions, and pull video and account stats.

w6w.longDescription:
Wistia hosts and analyzes marketing video. This app lets a workflow list, rename, tag, move and delete media; import a video from a URL and poll the background job that processes it; and create, update and delete folders and read their subfolders.

It also reads what happens after publishing: per-video and account-wide stats (loads, plays, play rate, hours watched, engagement), caption tracks and transcripts, tags, and the account's plan and usage, so a workflow can react to a video that is performing, or stop uploading when the plan is full.

Built on Wistia's current /modern API with a single API token. Folders are what Wistia used to call projects.
